tool.name: RADAR-PD Configure
tool.description: create a reusable Full or Rapid analysis configuration
tool.command: set -euo pipefail && python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py configure --mode '$analysis_mode' --radiation '$radiation' --instrument-mode '$instrument_mode' --allowed-elements '$sample_elements' --environment-elements '$environment_elements' #if str($pattern.limit_start) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') --limit-start '$pattern.limit_start' #end if #if str($pattern.limit_end) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') --limit-end '$pattern.limit_end' #end if #for $region in $pattern.excluded_regions --exclude-region '${region.start}:${region.end}' #end for --background-mode '$background.background_mode' --background-type '$background.background_type' --background-terms '$background.background_terms' --max-passes '$budgets.max_passes' --min-phase-percent '$budgets.min_phase_percent' --phases-per-hypothesis '$budgets.phases_per_hypothesis' --gsas-validation-limit '$budgets.gsas_validation_limit' $advanced.magnetic_precheck $advanced.main_prenudge $advanced.main_shadow_filter $advanced.main_cleanup $advanced.refine_uiso $advanced.refine_positions --output '$config_output' --report '$config_report' > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)

param.name: sample_elements
param.label: Sample elements
param.help: Comma- or space-separated element symbols, for example Cu, P, Pb, O, S.

param.name: environment_elements
param.label: Sample can / environment elements
param.help: Elements that may occur as pure environment phases but should not be freely mixed into sample chemistry.

param.name: phases_per_hypothesis
param.label: Rapid mode candidate phases per hypothesis

param.name: gsas_validation_limit
param.label: Final refinement shortlist size
param.help: Set to zero to stop after pattern scoring.

param.name: magnetic_precheck
param.label: Check whether residual peaks support commensurate magnetic ordering

param.name: main_prenudge
param.label: Automatically anchor a supplied main-phase cell

param.name: main_shadow_filter
param.label: Filter candidates explained only by strong main-phase peaks

param.name: main_cleanup
param.label: Refine supplied main-CIF internal parameters after lattice anchoring

param.name: refine_positions
param.label: Refine main-phase atomic positions during cleanup

tool.help: Creates a portable RADAR-PD configuration that contains scientific settings but no machine-specific file paths. Use it with the RADAR-PD Analyze tool for either uploaded/history datasets or optional SNS IPTS resolution. The same configuration can be reused in mapped Galaxy workflows and with the hosted RADAR-PD API.
